page_title: MON 4-0 REN | Monaco v Rennes 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
90+4' Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul after Elias Legendre (Rennes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Mika Biereth. The score is now 4:0.
87' The total number of attempts is 12:5.
84' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Denis Zakaria departs the field of play to be replaced by Aladji Bamba (Monaco).
81' The game has come to an end for Aleksandr Golovin. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Stanis Idumbo (Monaco).
79' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Elias Legendre (Rennes) replaces Mousa Tamari.

78' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
78' The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
77' Mika Biereth (Monaco) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
75' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Breel Embolo (Rennes) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
72' A substitution has been made. Krepin Diatta goes off and Vanderson (Monaco) comes on.
67' The foul by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) was seen by Ruddy Buquet who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
66' That will be all from Djaoui Cisse who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Glen Kamara (Rennes).
64' Excellent touch by Mika Biereth (Monaco)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
62' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
60' 3 - 0 Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Brice Samba with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 3:0.
56' Mika Biereth (Monaco) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
56' Substitution. Mika Biereth (Monaco) in, Folarin Balogun out.
56' Substitution. Esteban Lepaul did his best and is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
56' Here is a change. Przemyslaw Frankowski is going off and Habib Beye gives the last tactical orders to Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
56' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lilian Brassier.
53' The goal by Rennes is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
53' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Rennes players aren’t happy.
52' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
50' No offside! Referee Ruddy Buquet points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Monaco players.
50' Wait! Referee Ruddy Buquet has indicated he is going to review the Monaco goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
50' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Aleksandr Golovin sprays a pass out to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
50' A great pass puts Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
49' Rennes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' Here's the change. Ansu Fati leaves the pitch and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) comes on as a substitute.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Ruddy Buquet has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+5' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Monaco force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+4' Ansu Fati (Monaco) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' It looks like Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) saw red with that tackle. Ruddy Buquet won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
40' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

37' Philipp Kohn pulls off a fantastic save! Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
36' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' 1 - 0 Goal Ansu Fati (Monaco)! Ansu Fati (Monaco) was put through by Folarin Balogun and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
28' Ruddy Buquet shows a yellow card to Lilian Brassier (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
27' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
25' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes.
23' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
22' Jordan Teze (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Ruddy Buquet and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
18' Great save! Mahdi Camara (Rennes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Philipp Kohn.

16' What a chance that is! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post! The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
12' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Breel Embolo (Rennes) was quite harsh and Ruddy Buquet didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Philipp Kohn is alert and denies him with a nice save.

7' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
6' The ball is out of play and Monaco manage to earn a corner.
4' Monaco enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has started.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Ruddy Buquet will officiate today.
